clue.text: Polite British characters, nothing less — in this?

definitions.text: Polite British characters, nothing less — in this?

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are treated as loose characters to be set out in a new order
less means the following item is taken away from the words before it

parts.note: nothing is zero, the round letter O

explanation.surface: A theatregoer wonders whether a certain play is peopled by well-mannered Britons and nobody else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'characters' is the anagram signal on POLITE BRITISH once 'less' has taken out the O for 'nothing'; the whole clue then describes Noel Coward's comedy, full of genteel English types.
explanation.definitionFit: Noel Coward's comedy about a mischievous ghost is populated by genteel, well-spoken English people, so it fits the whole clue as a description.

clue.text: Keep away from footballer with a smell

parts.note: a back is a defensive football player
food that has gone off smells bad

explanation.surface: Avoiding a footballer who is rather pungent.
explanation.definitionFit: To retreat or stay at a distance is to withdraw.

clue.text: I uprooted part of fairway, dropping five — I'm a fool

indicators.note: dropping means the Roman five is taken out

parts.note: a divot is a chunk of turf torn up by a golf club
V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: A golfer confesses foolishness after hacking up turf and taking five shots.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I'm a' is a link turning the clue into the golfer's confession.
explanation.definitionFit: A dimwit or simpleton is a stupid person.

clue.text: Man's girl upset by statistical display

parts.note: his means belonging to a man

indicators.note: upset in a down clue turns the name upside down, so it reads backwards

parts.note: Margot is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A man's girlfriend is distressed by a chart of figures.
explanation.definitionFit: A bar chart showing frequency distribution is a statistical graphic.

clue.text: White water expert disappearing from on top

indicators.note: disappearing from means the expert vanishes out of the longer word

parts.note: something on the surface is on top
an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: A white-water expert falls off the top of the raft.
explanation.definitionFit: Breaking waves foaming on the shore make the frothy sea.

clue.text: Ruler's put in danger, going round capital of Austria

indicators.note: going round means the danger word encircles the capital letter

parts.note: to imperil is to put in danger

indicators.note: capital of takes the first letter of Austria

explanation.surface: An emperor is endangered by travel around the Austrian capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Belonging to an emperor or empire, hence of a sovereign.

clue.text: Force a round song out of 5

indicators.note: out of means the turned song is removed from the earlier answer

parts.note: the answer to 5 down is imperial

indicators.note: round means the song is turned about so it reads backwards

parts.note: an air is a song

explanation.surface: Compelling a song to be sung in a round.
explanation.walkthrough: The held clue lost the cross-reference '5', which the scan shows; 'round' turns the song backwards before 'out of' removes it from that answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To drive or propel someone is to compel them.

clue.text: Song kept up by high speed street band

indicators.note: kept means the turned song is held inside the speed

parts.note: Mach 1, written MACH I, is the speed of sound

indicators.note: up in a down clue sends the song upwards, reading backwards

parts.note: an air is a song

explanation.surface: A tune is sustained by a fast-moving group of street musicians.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' turns the song backwards and 'kept' puts it inside the speed of sound; 'by' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Strolling Mexican musicians who play in streets and restaurants form a folk group.

clue.text: Asian doctor with new record turnover

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, a doctor

indicators.note: turnover means the record is turned over to read backwards

parts.note: a log is a record

explanation.surface: An Asian physician with a fresh sales record.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Mongolia, in central Asia, is a person from that continent.

clue.text: Church in pieces recalled tile fixer

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: recalled is read as called back, so the word for pieces runs in reverse

parts.note: pieces are parts

explanation.surface: Bits of a church are remembered by a roofer who lays tiles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tile' is slang for a hat, not a roof slate; a chinstrap holds a hat in place.
explanation.definitionFit: A strap under the jaw keeps headgear, jocularly a tile, firmly on the head.

clue.text: A grand, say, that can be reduced to a penny?

definitions.text: A grand, say, that can be reduced to a penny?

parts.words: A grand, say, that can be reduced to a penny
parts.note: a grand is a kind of keyboard instrument, and the musical direction for soft shares its one-letter abbreviation p with the penny

explanation.surface: Someone muses on whether a thousand pounds could shrink to a single coin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grand' looks like a thousand pounds; it is the concert instrument, whose name as a dynamic marking is abbreviated p, the same letter as penny.
explanation.definitionFit: A grand is one type of this keyboard instrument, and as the musical term for soft it shortens to p, the symbol for a penny.

clue.text: Be smarter than escaped animal

parts.note: an escaped prisoner is out
the fox is an animal

explanation.surface: Getting the better of a creature that has broken loose.
explanation.definitionFit: To outwit someone is to beat them through cunning, being cleverer than they are.

clue.text: Questions the action of fire?

definitions.meaning: questions here is a plural noun loosely standing for an intense interrogation, as when police subject a suspect to hard questioning
cooking under a direct flame or heat source is what a grill does

explanation.definitionFit: Intense interrogation is a common idiom for hard questioning, and it is also cooking food under radiant heat.

clue.text: Vehicle's reversing provided plenty of space

indicators.note: reversing tells us the word for provided runs backwards

parts.note: provided, as in on condition that, is if
an acre is a generous area of land

explanation.surface: A car backing out because there was lots of room.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after 'Vehicle' is a link, not part of the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A small four-wheeled hackney carriage once common in Paris is a horse-drawn vehicle.

clue.text: Saw hot ring through a spectrum producer

indicators.note: through means the pieces pass into the middle of the other words

parts.note: a prism splits light into a spectrum
a ring is round, like the letter O

explanation.surface: A heated ring passes through a prism making a rainbow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like a tool or a verb; it is a saying.
explanation.definitionFit: An old saw is a pithy proverb, a terse maxim.

clue.text: Distant US state contains islands? Ridiculous!

parts.note: distant means far
CI stands for the Channel Islands
CAL is an abbreviation of California

explanation.surface: Surprise that a faraway American state includes islands.
explanation.definitionFit: Something absurd enough to belong in a stage farce is laughably silly.

clue.text: Can pig and sow dodge the blade?

indicators.note: a dodge is a trick, so the letters are worked into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Asking whether farm pigs can escape the butcher's knife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' joins the fodder and gives no letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A thin-bladed frame saw for cutting curves is a cutting tool.

clue.text: Familiar officer mostly takes a ship round floating weed

indicators.note: mostly means the last letter is cut from the officer

parts.note: Sarge is a familiar form of sergeant
SS is steamship
a round thing is like the letter O

explanation.surface: A friendly sergeant takes a vessel round the seaweed.
explanation.definitionFit: A brown seaweed with air bladders floats in great mats in the Atlantic.

clue.text: Unconventional type in a big way gripped by tea addiction at last

indicators.note: gripped by means the road is held within the word for tea

parts.note: bohea is a black China tea
the M1 is Britain's main motorway, written MI

indicators.note: at last picks the final letter of addiction

explanation.surface: A free spirit, hugely dependent on tea in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a big way' looks like an adverb, but 'a big way' is the M1, the London-to-Yorkshire motorway, read as MI.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist living free of social convention is the classic arty nonconformist.

clue.text: Become live resort

parts.note: to be is to exist or live
Hove is a seaside resort next to Brighton in Sussex

explanation.surface: Becoming a resident of a resort town.
explanation.walkthrough: HOVE is a south-coast English seaside town; 'Become' means suit or befit, not turn into.
explanation.definitionFit: Become here means to befit or be appropriate, the sense of be fitting for someone.

clue.text: Taking pick, work metal with gusto initially

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a work
tin is a metal

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of gusto

explanation.surface: Choosing a pickaxe and working metal enthusiastically.
explanation.definitionFit: Choosing is taking one's pick among options.

clue.text: Start to scream after seeing mutant birth

indicators.note: after places the first letter of scream after the anagram
mutant means altered, so the letters change their order
start to picks the first letter of scream

explanation.surface: A scream begins when someone sees a mutant being born.
explanation.definitionFit: An origin or coming into being, like the first book of the Bible, is a beginning.

clue.text: All we're left with is present containing a single ticket

indicators.note: containing means the word for present wraps round the other pieces

parts.note: present, as in in attendance, is here
a single is one, the Roman numeral I
a tag is a label or ticket

explanation.surface: A gift holding one ticket is all that remains to us.
explanation.definitionFit: What earlier generations hand down to us is our legacy.

clue.text: A scoundrel coming up to pinch one crown

indicators.note: to pinch means the turned pieces grip the letter for one
coming up in a down clue reverses the pieces

parts.note: a rat is a scoundrel
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A villain rises to steal a crown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming up' turns A RAT into TARA, which then holds I.
explanation.definitionFit: A jewelled head ornament like a diadem is a kind of crown.

clue.text: Fashionable act is succeeding

parts.note: something fashionable is in
a turn is a performer's act

explanation.surface: A trendy act is doing well.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming one after another in order is following in sequence.

clue.text: Complete fool loses his head

indicators.note: loses his head means the first letter is removed

parts.note: a nutter is a crazy person

explanation.surface: A total idiot gets decapitated.
explanation.definitionFit: Utter means absolute or total.

clue.text: Part of leg seen kicking up, in part

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the run reads upwards, backwards
in part means only a portion of the words seen kicking is used

explanation.surface: A leg joint glimpsed as someone kicks upward.
explanation.walkthrough: Letters inside 'seen kicking' read upwards give the joint.
explanation.definitionFit: The joint between thigh and shin is a section of the leg.

clue.text: Panorama first seen in US state

indicators.note: seen in means the abbreviation for first appears inside the state

parts.note: VA is the abbreviation for Virginia
1st, written IST, is first

explanation.surface: A view first glimpsed in an American state.
explanation.definitionFit: A wide scenic view is a sweeping prospect.

clue.text: Crime is enveloping America: it may cause inflamed feelings for some

definitions.text: may cause inflamed feelings for some

indicators.note: enveloping means the outer letters wrap round the following pieces

parts.note: a sin is a wrongdoing
taken as written
US is the United States
taken as written

explanation.surface: A remark that crime surrounding America may inflame feelings in some people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inflamed feelings' hints at anger but is literal: swollen, inflamed sinuses felt as pain and pressure in the face.
explanation.definitionFit: Inflammation of the facial cavities brings painful swollen sensations, so it causes inflamed feelings in sufferers.

clue.text: Admit being wrong to make a meal of role?

definitions.meaning: to retract what one said and accept being mistaken

definitions.text: to make a meal of role?
definitions.meaning: an actor's role is their lines, so consuming them is literally swallowing those lines

explanation.definitionFit: Retracting a claim is the idiom, and literally dining on an actor's lines is the playful second sense.
